pm_active.meaning: executeHedge is invoked while the HyperLiquid PM integration is active

blp_reserve_exists.meaning: BLP has an active reserve for the spot asset bought by executeHedge

accounting_reads_revert.meaning: accounting reads (surplus, distributableSurplus, settleDailyPnL gate 3) revert due to the registered never-supplied token

assumptions: executeHedge buys the spot asset on L1 and calls notifyVaultSupply to register it in vaultSupplied.
Registration in vaultSupplied is unconditional with no check that BLP has an active reserve for the token.
Recovery from the bricked state requires an operator to call removeSuppliedEntry.

unresolved.description: Report describes the no-BLP-reserve condition only conditionally; no concrete triggering transaction or reserve-state snapshot is supplied.
Report does not specify the exact failure response or revert reason from the 0x811 precompile suppliedBalance call.

limitations: Authorization/caller of executeHedge is not stated; condition is limited to PM-active and absent-BLP-reserve facts.
The impact is formalized as the absence of accounting-read reverts; the specific revert reason is not modeled.
